name: Return all your categories
description: Return all your categories. Retrieve a paginated list of all ecommerce categories stored in your Brevo account. Results are sorted by creation date in descending order by default, and can be filtered by category IDs, name, modification date, creation date, or deletion status. The response includes a `count` field with the total number of matching categories, and pagination defaults to 50 categories per page (maximum 100).
